apps.name: Axolotl
apps.subtitle: Markdown notes with private sync
apps.localizedDescription: A beautiful, private, Markdown-first notes app with tags, todos, wiki links, locked notes, themes and end-to-end encrypted sync between your devices.

versions.localizedDescription: Agents: Siri, Shortcuts and Apple Intelligence can create, search, open and update notes and todos. On the Mac, an MCP server and the axolotl command let Claude, Cursor and other AI agents use every Axolotl feature.

Performance and security release: much faster editing in long notes, faster launch with large libraries, image loading off the main thread, locked notes now also remove their earlier plaintext history, stronger password hashing, relay responses are verified, and the sync relay gained quotas and streaming uploads.
A new icon and look: Markdown syntax hides itself except on the line you're editing, new Axolotl and Axolotl Night themes, cleaner note list and previews.

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Axolotl finds your other devices on this network to sync notes directly and privately.
privacy.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Axolotl uses Face ID to unlock the app and your locked notes.
privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Axolotl uses the camera to scan documents and sync-code QR codes.
